title: SACTCheck regimen information and evidence pilot

governance.operational_authority: The current NCCP protocol remains the operational source for treatment assessment, eligibility, monitoring and dose modification.
governance.evidence_boundary: Publication summaries provide educational context only and do not alter the deterministic SACTCheck result.
governance.content_status: AI-assisted paraphrased draft content requiring Consultant Oncology and oncology-pharmacy review before clinical validation.

drug_profiles.name: Trifluridine/tipiracil
drug_profiles.drug_class: Thymidine-based nucleoside analogue with thymidine phosphorylase inhibitor
drug_profiles.mechanism: Trifluridine is incorporated into DNA and disrupts DNA function. Tipiracil inhibits thymidine phosphorylase, increasing systemic exposure to trifluridine.

drug_profiles.name: Fluorouracil
drug_profiles.mechanism: Intracellular metabolites inhibit thymidylate synthase and can be incorporated into RNA and DNA, disrupting nucleic-acid synthesis and function.

drug_profiles.name: Folinic acid
drug_profiles.mechanism: Stabilises the fluorouracil–thymidylate synthase complex, enhancing fluorouracil-mediated inhibition of thymidylate synthesis. It is not itself a cytotoxic component in these regimens.

drug_profiles.name: Oxaliplatin
drug_profiles.mechanism: Forms platinum–DNA adducts and cross-links that interfere with DNA replication and transcription, leading to cell death.

drug_profiles.name: Irinotecan
drug_profiles.mechanism: Its active metabolite SN-38 stabilises the topoisomerase I–DNA complex, preventing repair of single-strand breaks during DNA replication.

drug_profiles.name: Durvalumab
drug_profiles.mechanism: Binds PD-L1 and blocks its interaction with PD-1 and CD80, supporting restoration of antitumour T-cell activity.

drug_profiles.name: Pembrolizumab
drug_profiles.mechanism: Binds PD-1 and blocks interaction with PD-L1 and PD-L2, reducing inhibitory signalling in activated T cells.

drug_profiles.name: Nivolumab
drug_profiles.mechanism: Binds PD-1 and blocks ligand-mediated inhibitory signalling, supporting antitumour T-cell responses.

drug_profiles.name: Atezolizumab
drug_profiles.mechanism: Binds PD-L1 and blocks interactions with PD-1 and CD80, reducing checkpoint-mediated suppression of T-cell activity.

drug_profiles.name: Pemetrexed
drug_profiles.mechanism: Inhibits folate-dependent enzymes involved in purine and thymidylate synthesis, impairing DNA and RNA synthesis.

drug_profiles.name: Carboplatin
drug_profiles.mechanism: Forms platinum–DNA adducts and cross-links that disrupt DNA replication and transcription.

drug_profiles.name: Paclitaxel
drug_profiles.mechanism: Promotes microtubule assembly and prevents normal microtubule disassembly, disrupting mitosis and intracellular transport.

drug_profiles.name: Docetaxel
drug_profiles.mechanism: Stabilises microtubules and inhibits their depolymerisation, causing disruption of mitotic and cellular functions.

drug_profiles.name: Doxorubicin
drug_profiles.mechanism: Intercalates into DNA, inhibits topoisomerase II and generates reactive species, causing DNA damage and impaired replication.

drug_profiles.name: Pegylated liposomal doxorubicin
drug_profiles.mechanism: Delivers doxorubicin in a pegylated liposomal formulation. Released doxorubicin intercalates DNA and inhibits topoisomerase II.

drug_profiles.name: Cyclophosphamide
drug_profiles.mechanism: Hepatic activation produces metabolites that form DNA cross-links, interfering with DNA replication and cell division.

drug_profiles.name: Trastuzumab
drug_profiles.mechanism: Binds the extracellular domain of HER2, inhibiting signalling and promoting immune-mediated destruction of HER2-expressing tumour cells.

drug_profiles.name: Pertuzumab
drug_profiles.mechanism: Binds a different extracellular HER2 domain from trastuzumab and inhibits ligand-dependent HER2 dimerisation with other HER family receptors.

drug_profiles.name: Abemaciclib
drug_profiles.mechanism: Inhibits cyclin-dependent kinases 4 and 6, reducing retinoblastoma-protein phosphorylation and limiting progression from G1 to S phase.

drug_profiles.name: Bevacizumab
drug_profiles.mechanism: Binds VEGF-A and reduces activation of VEGF receptors, inhibiting tumour-associated angiogenic signalling.

drug_profiles.name: Gemcitabine
drug_profiles.mechanism: Active metabolites inhibit ribonucleotide reductase and are incorporated into DNA, impairing DNA synthesis.

drug_profiles.name: Cisplatin
drug_profiles.mechanism: Forms intra- and inter-strand DNA cross-links that disrupt DNA replication and transcription.

drug_profiles.name: Axitinib
drug_profiles.mechanism: Inhibits VEGFR-1, VEGFR-2 and VEGFR-3 signalling, reducing angiogenesis and tumour vascular growth.

drug_profiles.name: Enfortumab vedotin
drug_profiles.drug_class: Nectin-4-directed antibody linked to a microtubule-disrupting payload
drug_profiles.mechanism: Binds Nectin-4, is internalised and releases monomethyl auristatin E, which disrupts microtubules and induces cell death.

evidence_records.publication_title: Randomized Trial of TAS-102 for Refractory Metastatic Colorectal Cancer
evidence_records.relevance_summary: Supports trifluridine/tipiracil in refractory metastatic colorectal cancer after standard therapies.
evidence_records.limitations: Trial eligibility and monitoring do not replace the current NCCP protocol or individual clinical assessment.

evidence_records.publication_title: Oxaliplatin, Fluorouracil, and Leucovorin as Adjuvant Treatment for Colon Cancer
evidence_records.relevance_summary: Established the clinical value of adding oxaliplatin to fluorouracil and folinic acid in adjuvant colon cancer.
evidence_records.limitations: The trial used FOLFOX4 rather than the exact modified FOLFOX-6 schedule and does not cover every indication listed in the shared NCCP protocol.

evidence_records.publication_title: Irinotecan Combined with Fluorouracil Compared with Fluorouracil Alone as First-Line Treatment for Metastatic Colorectal Cancer
evidence_records.relevance_summary: Supports the irinotecan, fluorouracil and folinic-acid backbone used in FOLFIRI for metastatic colorectal cancer.
evidence_records.limitations: The NCCP protocol includes additional disease settings; the publication does not validate every listed indication or every local schedule detail.

evidence_records.publication_title: FOLFIRINOX versus Gemcitabine for Metastatic Pancreatic Cancer
evidence_records.relevance_summary: Supports FOLFIRINOX as a first-line option in selected patients with metastatic pancreatic cancer.
evidence_records.limitations: The trial enrolled patients with good performance status; its population and full-dose schedule should not be extrapolated without reference to the current protocol.
evidence_records.match_type: Exact regimen family and disease setting

evidence_records.publication_title: FOLFIRINOX or Gemcitabine as Adjuvant Therapy for Pancreatic Cancer
evidence_records.evidence_context: Adjuvant treatment after resection of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
evidence_records.relevance_summary: Supports modified FOLFIRINOX in the adjuvant pancreatic-cancer setting.
evidence_records.limitations: The NCCP protocol also includes metastatic treatment; this publication specifically supports the adjuvant context.
evidence_records.match_type: Exact modified regimen in adjuvant context

evidence_records.publication_title: Durvalumab after Chemoradiotherapy in Stage III Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer
evidence_records.evidence_context: Unresectable stage III NSCLC without progression after concurrent chemoradiotherapy
evidence_records.relevance_summary: Supports consolidation durvalumab following definitive concurrent chemoradiotherapy in the studied stage III NSCLC population.
evidence_records.limitations: Current NCCP and European eligibility criteria, including biomarker requirements, remain authoritative.

evidence_records.publication_title: Pembrolizumab plus Chemotherapy in Metastatic Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer
evidence_records.evidence_context: Previously untreated metastatic non-squamous NSCLC without EGFR or ALK alterations
evidence_records.relevance_summary: Supports pembrolizumab with pemetrexed and platinum chemotherapy in the specified first-line metastatic non-squamous NSCLC setting.
evidence_records.limitations: The trial allowed cisplatin or carboplatin; the NCCP protocol defines the locally encoded schedule and treatment criteria.

evidence_records.publication_title: Pembrolizumab for Early Triple-Negative Breast Cancer
evidence_records.relevance_summary: Supports neoadjuvant pembrolizumab with chemotherapy followed by adjuvant pembrolizumab in high-risk early triple-negative breast cancer.
evidence_records.limitations: The complete trial sequence and eligibility criteria should be checked against the current NCCP protocol; this record does not substitute for phase-specific assessment.
evidence_records.match_type: Exact treatment strategy; local phase schedule encoded separately

evidence_records.publication_title: Pertuzumab plus Trastuzumab in Combination with Standard Neoadjuvant Anthracycline-Containing and Anthracycline-Free Chemotherapy Regimens in Patients with HER2-Positive Early Breast Cancer
evidence_records.evidence_context: Neoadjuvant HER2-positive early or locally advanced breast cancer
evidence_records.relevance_summary: Included an anthracycline-free docetaxel, carboplatin, trastuzumab and pertuzumab cohort relevant to TCHP.
evidence_records.limitations: The study was phase 2 and designed primarily around cardiac safety rather than a definitive comparative efficacy endpoint.
evidence_records.match_type: Exact component combination in a trial cohort

evidence_records.publication_title: Adjuvant Trastuzumab in HER2-Positive Breast Cancer
evidence_records.relevance_summary: Evaluated the non-anthracycline docetaxel, carboplatin and trastuzumab regimen used as TCH.
evidence_records.limitations: Patient selection, duration of trastuzumab and current supportive-care standards should be checked against the current NCCP protocol.
evidence_records.match_type: Exact TCH regimen and adjuvant setting

evidence_records.publication_title: Abemaciclib Combined With Endocrine Therapy for the Adjuvant Treatment of HR-Positive, HER2-Negative, Node-Positive, High-Risk Early Breast Cancer
evidence_records.evidence_context: High-risk node-positive HR-positive, HER2-negative early breast cancer
evidence_records.relevance_summary: Supports adding adjuvant abemaciclib to endocrine therapy in the trial-defined high-risk population.
evidence_records.limitations: Eligibility definitions and biomarker requirements have evolved; the current NCCP protocol is authoritative for present-day use.

evidence_records.publication_title: Atezolizumab plus Bevacizumab in Unresectable Hepatocellular Carcinoma
evidence_records.relevance_summary: Supports atezolizumab plus bevacizumab in the studied first-line unresectable HCC population.
evidence_records.limitations: Trial eligibility included liver-function and bleeding-risk criteria; current NCCP assessment and local hepatology pathways remain authoritative.

evidence_records.publication_title: Durvalumab plus Gemcitabine and Cisplatin in Advanced Biliary Tract Cancer
evidence_records.evidence_context: Previously untreated unresectable or metastatic biliary tract cancer
evidence_records.relevance_summary: Supports durvalumab with gemcitabine and cisplatin in the first-line advanced biliary-tract cancer setting.
evidence_records.limitations: The trial treatment sequence and eligibility criteria should be interpreted through the current NCCP protocol and local practice.

evidence_records.publication_title: Pembrolizumab plus Axitinib versus Sunitinib for Advanced Renal-Cell Carcinoma
evidence_records.relevance_summary: Supports first-line pembrolizumab plus axitinib in advanced renal-cell carcinoma.
evidence_records.limitations: The current NCCP protocol governs present eligibility, monitoring and dose-modification requirements.

evidence_records.publication_title: Enfortumab Vedotin and Pembrolizumab in Untreated Advanced Urothelial Cancer
evidence_records.evidence_context: Previously untreated locally advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma
evidence_records.relevance_summary: Supports first-line enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab in advanced urothelial carcinoma.
evidence_records.limitations: The publication does not replace the current NCCP criteria, toxicity pathways or component-specific dose guidance.

evidence_records.publication_title: Pembrolizumab in Microsatellite-Instability-High Advanced Colorectal Cancer
evidence_records.evidence_context: First-line MSI-high or mismatch-repair-deficient metastatic colorectal cancer
evidence_records.relevance_summary: Supports pembrolizumab monotherapy in the colorectal indication encoded within this shared pembrolizumab protocol.
evidence_records.limitations: This NCCP protocol is shared across multiple tumour types; KEYNOTE-177 supports only the MSI-high or mismatch-repair-deficient colorectal context.
evidence_records.match_type: Context-specific evidence within a shared protocol

evidence_records.publication_title: First-Line Nivolumab plus Chemotherapy versus Chemotherapy Alone for Advanced Gastric, Gastro-Oesophageal Junction, and Oesophageal Adenocarcinoma
evidence_records.evidence_context: Previously untreated advanced gastric, gastro-oesophageal junction or oesophageal adenocarcinoma
evidence_records.relevance_summary: Supports nivolumab with fluoropyrimidine and oxaliplatin chemotherapy in the studied advanced gastro-oesophageal adenocarcinoma population.
evidence_records.limitations: The trial permitted FOLFOX or CAPOX; the NCCP protocol defines the exact mFOLFOX6 implementation and current biomarker criteria.
evidence_records.match_type: Exact immunotherapy plus equivalent chemotherapy backbone

evidence_records.publication_title: Pegylated Liposomal Doxorubicin and Carboplatin Compared with Paclitaxel and Carboplatin for Patients with Platinum-Sensitive Ovarian Cancer in Late Relapse
evidence_records.evidence_context: Platinum-sensitive recurrent ovarian, fallopian-tube or primary peritoneal cancer
evidence_records.relevance_summary: Supports carboplatin plus pegylated liposomal doxorubicin in platinum-sensitive recurrent ovarian cancer.
evidence_records.limitations: The trial population and schedule should be checked against the exact current NCCP indication and protocol version.
evidence_records.match_type: Exact component combination and recurrent setting
